_source.describes: Which of the map engine's abstract silhouettes each kind of site may be drawn inside.
_source.status: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.
_source.rationale: Layout instruction only. A row carries an id, a shape, the kinds it admits, whether it has water and how often it comes up — and no prose at all, which is why this file can ship complete while the tables that hold words are still empty.
